notes.title: Halloween Update (version 1.02)
notes.content:
[h1] We just uploaded an update that adds some new content and improves controller support. [/h1]

[list]
[*]New level "Hell" added (to unlock it in single player, all other maps must be completed).
[*]New zombie customization objects added.
[*]Main menu music added to the tracks that can be used in the level editor.
[*]Controller can now be used in nearly every menu.
[*]Fixed various movement bugs.
[*]Colors of glowing circles, skulls and arrows in the editor are now saved.
[*]The smaller hole setting on bars in the editor is now saved.
[*]Emotes can now be performed with the controller (control pad right).
[*]Fixed a bug that changed the game mode on user created maps.
[*]Fixed various movement bugs.
[*]Improved the overall performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
With this update, Blood Party leaves Early Access. We fixed a lot of bugs, added some new content and improved the movement in online matches. We hope you'll have some fun and build crazy maps with our new level set.

[list]
[*] New level set added.
[*] 3 new levels added.
[*] New item: Flamethrower.
[*] New trap: Bubble Spawner
[*] Shlorox hat added.
[*] Tinkerleo hat and outfit added.
[*] New zombie customization items added.
[*] Movement replication improved.
[*] Fixed the Smashing Fist collision for the level Editor.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented fans from working after a player died in them.
[*] Various Split Screen improvements.
[*] All achievements are now available
[*] Trap door position in workshop maps fixed.
[*] Setting the color for small squares now works.
[*] Various minor map changes.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed the Smashing Fist collision for the level Editor.
Fixed a bug that prevented fans from working after a player died in them.
Trap door position in workshop maps fixed.
Setting the color for small squares now works.
Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update (version 0.7.1)
notes.content:
[h1]We just uploaded an update that adds a new arena to the editor, adds two new game maps and fixes various bugs. [/h1]

[list]

[*] Sky Pool arena added to the editor.
[*] Level "Neon Death" added.

[*] Shotgun aim improvements.
[*] Two new hairstyles added to the zombie editor.

[*] Meatgrinder is fixed and now always spawns one meat block per zombie.
[*] Tutorial achievement fixed.
[*] Breakable wood walls break with the first hit now.
[*] Improved sounds when being killed by acid.

[*] The goal in co-op maps can't be activated with single body parts anymore.
[*] Syringe acid can't kill zombies directly after they spawn anymore.
[*] Various fixes for the cannon.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.


[/list]

notes.title: Update (version 0.6.2)
notes.content:
[h1]We just uploaded an update that adds the kitchen level set, kitchen map and the dublicate tool to the editor, changes the functionality of the syringe and fixes various bugs. [/h1]

[list]

[*] Kitchen objects and kitchen map added to the level editor.
[*] Head and feet material adjusted, so that there is no difference to the body material.
[*] Movie effects (grain and fringe) can now be deactivated in the options menu.
[*] Syringe functionality added. It now spawns decals that kill players when they are touched.
[*] When exiting the editor testing mode, buttons, gates etc. will be reset.
[*] Rotation and attributes of editor objects are saved now, as long as they are not deselected.
[*] Duplicate function added to the editor.
[*] The two player platform can be activated alone, while testing a map in the editor, which makes it much easier to test co-op maps there.
[*] Spoon and Shotgun attack animation changed. It's now better visible when you can attack again.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from standing up after crouching on buttons and various platforms (again).
[*] Aiming with the cannon in editor testing mode is now possible.
[*] Various animation improvements.
[*] The thumbnail cam has a preview now when you place it.
[*] Sprinting and head throwing in editor testing mode fixed.
[*] Items drop now when zombies are ignited.
[*] Text box for description texts of Workshop maps for host game and in the lobby fixed.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.
[*] Various minor level changes.

[/list]

notes.title: Update (version 0.6.1)
notes.content:
[h1]We just uploaded an update that adds some new content and fixes various bugs and issues. [/h1]

[list]

[*] New zombie customization assets: cat ears, beer helmet, bearded head, suit, body with holes.
[*] New map added: Patorra Tower 3.
[*] Players can ignite each other now while burning.
[*] Performance on Workshop maps is much better now (30-40%).
[*] Server list can now be refreshed with f5.
[*] Key assignment for showing the scoreboard can now be changed.
[*] Block colors are now saved and will show correctly in Workshop maps.
[*] Added 3840*1080 resolution (for Splitscreen, there are still problems with this)
[*] Moving squares work correctly now.
[*] Jumping behavior for the head improved.
[*] Fixed chat bugs (loss of focus, messages being send by other players respawning).
[*] Chat messages are longer visible now.
[*] Fixed the trigger platforms (can be connected to buttons now).
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the head from being thrown in splitscreen mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from standing up on co-op platforms when crouched.
[*] Fixed various collisions.
[*] Fixed a bug that led to items hanging mid-air when beeing killed or die.
[*] Fixed the 1366x768 resolution.
[*] Various minor fixes.

[/list]

notes.content:

[*]Fixed the mines. They sometimes exploded two times.
[*]Fixed the cannon. In user created maps, the cannon wasn't movable.
[*]Various smaller map changes.
